objective: Evaluate whether a fixed high-bank recharge-restart margin remains inside the pressure-cycle distribution of a second owner-controlled station-side bundle after explicit unit normalization.

method.within_file_ordering: stable ascending timestamp sort; retain last source-order observation for duplicate timestamps
method.filter: causal rolling median after chronological sort
method.skip_rows_after_header: bundle-specific owner mapping, applied before sampling
method.pressure_normalization: owner-attested unit scale to MPa before cycle detection

decision_boundary.pass_meaning: Station-side cross-bundle corroboration of a fixed restart-margin candidate under the declared pressure-cycle method.

claim_boundary: This protocol tests only owner-controlled station-side storage-pressure-cycle transfer. It does not validate vehicle filling, leak or fire consequence predictions, accident frequency, sensor performance, or field safety limits.
